afterburner.long: Don’t think, just sweat. Using functional movements in a partnered circuit format with a variety of equipment, take your fitness to new levels. A high-intensity class that pushes EPOC (excess post-oxygen consumption) so that your body keeps working even after the session has finished. All levels welcome. Suitable for all, from newbies to seasoned pros. Your trainer will spend time demonstrating how to perform the moves correctly to prevent injury and get the most from the class. Varied movements Battle ropes, assault bikes and TRX are just some of the pieces equipment used in Afterburner to vary the workout.

bjj fundamentals.long: Learning the fundamental positions, movements and techniques of Brazilian Jiu Jitsu. A grappling based martial art which uses takedowns, throws, pins and submissions to combat your opponent. This class is ideal for those new to Jiu Jitsu and grappling. Rules and progression. BJJ Academy Overview BJJ Academy House Rules. BJJ Academy Progression Guide

boxing.long: Take your boxing skills to the next level by working on pads. You will learn not only how to punch the pads, but also how to hold them. This is a more advanced class which will incorporate footwork, head movement, and complex combinations. Members are kindly requested to bring their own boxing gloves and wraps (these can be purchased at Concierge).

boxing fundamentals.long: Learn boxing fundamentals. Beginners will be taught the correct stance, the precise technique for punches, and effective boxing movements. Advanced boxers will improve their form and progress their technique. Members are kindly requested to bring their own boxing gloves and wraps (these can be purchased at Concierge).

boxing sparring advanced only.long: This is an advanced class for members who are ready to step into the ring and engage in contact sparring. Please seek pre-approval from a member of the combat team before booking. Head-guards and gum shields are absolutely essential and members are kindly requested to bring their own boxing gloves and wraps (these can be purchased at Concierge).

dynamic reformer.long: Minimal rest, maximum results. Increase the tempo in this advanced reformer class. Dynamic Reformer combines contemporary Pilates and functional movements to create a high-intensity challenge for the whole body. Designed to boost your heart rate and leave you feeling energised and accomplished. Feel better As a holistic exercise system, Pilates is designed to elongate and strengthen the body, build a strong core and improve posture. Move better Progressively challenging advanced classes to push your limits. Perform better

engine endurance.long: Engine Endurance is built to develop your aerobic fitness and lasting stamina. Expect longer efforts held at a controlled sustainable pace. Combining functional weighted movement with assault bikes, ski ergs, rowers.

engine intervals.long: Engine Intervals is built to push your top-end fitness through short bursts of high-intensity work. Using functional weighted movement alongside assault bikes, ski ergs, rowers and targeted conditioning, every session challenges your speed, power and ability to recover under fatigue.

force.long: A music driven barbell and dumbbell class designed to fatigue the whole body through higher repetitions creating muscular endurance. A great class for those new to weights or experienced lifters who want to feel the burn in a high energy but supported environment.

formula 3.long: This is the Formula to get you fit, fast. A competitive, high intensity circuit with 3 targeted blocks, for a full spectrum workout. First, cardio on Concept2 rowing machines; Second, strength with kettlebells and dumbbells; Finally, athletic power and speed with bodyweight exercises. Get fit in 3… 2… 1 All SystemS Go. Carefully curated with 3 blocks of 3 exercises to activate all 3 energy systems. Improve your; speed, strength and endurance in this high intensity, all round athletic workout. The Concept2 rower provides you with constant performance feedback with every stroke.

fundamental reformer pilates.long: No experience necessary. Whether you’re a Reformer beginner, healing from an injury, or want a slower class, start building your foundation here. Learn basic movements on the Reformer using spring tension, straps, and props. Fitted with straps, springs and a sliding carriage, the Reformer takes you from lying to seated to standing Pilates exercises. Improve posture, strength, and flexibility at your own pace and build the backbone of your training. As a holistic exercise system, Pilates is designed to elongate and strengthen the body, build a strong core and improve posture. Perform better.

hatha yoga.long: New to yoga? This is the class for you. Move at a slower pace to focus on each posture and alignment using pranayama – or conscious breathing exercises. With time to devote to your practice, Hatha Yoga combines balance, strength and wellbeing.

hyrox engine.long: Achieve more than you ever thought possible with our HYROX inspired class. Develop your functional fitness to become the ultimate HYBRID athlete. Combining strength, endurance and power focussed blocks working with ergs, wall balls, treadmills and more. Are you ready to test your overall fitness?

hyrox power.long: This class is built to help you dominate the HYROX stations and become the ultimate hybrid athlete. You’ll build endurance, strength and explosive power while fine-tuning your technique. Learn to stay powerful even when your heart rate is high.

hyrox run.long: Simulate the demands of fitness racing, combining muscular fatigue with interval running on the treadmill. Strength and power-based movements replace recovery between intervals to compromise your next run and improve cardiovascular endurance.

hyrox train.long: Develop your functional fitness to become the ultimate hybrid athlete and train to take part in a Hyrox fitness race event. Learn and improve exercise techniques to make every rep count. Attend up to 12 weeks of our progressive programming to get race ready.

just ride.long: Switch off. Just Ride. Tempo cardio intervals with climbs and sprints. Lose yourself in the music. Escape the City Leave the stresses of London behind. Tune in to the music and Just Ride. Switch Off No data. No screens. No competition. Just Ride is all about you, the bike and the music. No Ego Here

kettlebells.long: A dynamic full-body workout designed to boost core strength and enhance muscular endurance. A variety of kettlebell exercises target every major muscle group, helping you build power while shredding body fat.

lga.long: Legs, Glutes and Abs. Working some of the largest muscles in the body to create a high calorie burn. Expect a combination of strength and high intensity explosive exercises, aimed at increasing strength and flexibility to torch fat and sculpt the lower body.

lift.long: Create a strong, athletic and powerful body using progressively heavier weights under the careful instruction of your trainer. Improve your form and technique, building confidence in lifting weights whilst you sculpt your body. Leave the class feeling stronger and more powerful than ever. Build Confidence. Perfect for beginners and intermediates alike. Learn how to lift heavier weights safely, with correct form, taking this new confidence into the gym. Build Strength. Weight training is for absolutely everyone. Whatever your goals, strength training can help you achieve them. No Ego Here. Lift is about what you can do, not anyone else.

mat pilates fundamentals.long: Mat Pilates Fundamentals is a slower-paced class that emphasises precise instruction, with a strong focus on proper alignment and posture improvement. Each exercise is taught in detail to build a solid foundation and correct poor posture.

metaburn.long: A pyramid style, full body metabolic conditioning workout. Strengthen your body using resistance exercises interspersed with high intensity plyometric moves, building intensity throughout the workout. All levels welcome. Your trainer will ensure that you are working in a weight range that suits you. Members can book any of our classes 48 hours in advance. Work Rate. Whether you are trying to improve your mile time or get more out of your cycling classes, metabolic conditioning is for you. Strength exercises are broken up with short periods of maximal effort exercises to improve your athletic output. Plyometrics.

muay thai.long: Bringing all your skills together, hone your all-around fighting style to include counter-attacks, ring awareness and situational training in a controlled technical sparring environment. Introducing clinch work, and creating dominant positions, feel the progression you’ve made and improve upon it.

pulse.long: Set to the beat of the music, this low-impact barre workout uses ballet and Pilates inspired isometric strength training techniques to build strength, endurance and flexibility while improving joint mobility and stability. Open to all levels and abilities, including newbies and pre and post-natal members. Build Strength. Pulse targets and strengthens the lower body and core muscles to provide more stability and better posture whilst improving active flexibility. Hold the position and pulse. Isolate specific muscles and fatigue them quicker to increase muscular endurance and build strength. Pulse to the beat

rocket yoga.long: Fast and strong. Rooted in Ashtanga Vinyasa yoga, this challenging and playful practice incorporates inversions, arm balances, back-bends and standing balances to powerful, upbeat music. Suitable for enthusiastic beginners and experienced yoga practitioners alike.

skills drills.long: A front crawl focused session with varying skills and drills, concentrating on: the Catch, Push, Pull and recovery elements of your stroke.

sound bath.long: Lose yourself in deep relaxation and meditation. A unique soundscape of gongs, crystal bowls and percussion instruments will leave you feeling calm and rejuvenated. SLOW MIND ACTIVITY. Access deep mental and physical relaxation. Lie down, listen and absorb the sound vibrations. WORLD CLASS INSTRUCTORS. Our instructors lead you through an immersive, grounding experience to slow mind activity and heart rate. SLIP INTO MEDITATION. Tap into the benefits of traditional meditation without the silence.

speed fiends.long: Unlock your full running potential with focused interval training on the treadmill. Tailored to your individual pace and level, this 45-minute cardio-intensive class has an expert coach on hand offer motivation and guidance on your running form.

sweat x.long: Sweat with a purpose as you split the time equally between running and strength on and off the treadmill. Transform your training as you torch calories, build endurance and unleash your strength with this high intensity focused class set to an incredible playlist. Suitable for all levels. Pick up a headset from the instructor before the class starts. All levels welcome. Beginner, intermediate and advanced are all welcome here. Set your treadmill and weights to the right level with the help of your trainer and dig deep to reach your new personal best Interval training.

the wod.long: Your Workout of the Day. Inspired by cross training, expect “EMOMs” and “AMRAPs” as standard and be prepared to dig deep and push hard. The WOD combines effective high intensity training and strength work in an encouraging and motivating environment. All levels welcome Your trainer will ensure that you are working in a weight range that is right for you and sees you improving week on week. Functional Training There’s no hiding in The WOD, this is where hard work happens. By performing varied movements, at high intensity, The WOD will see you making progress in all areas of health and fitness. Motivation

tower pilates.long: Traditional Tower Pilates classes are an authentic blend of classical Pilates exercises and contemporary variations. Using spring tension to help support and challenge the whole body and build your core strength. This workout will strengthen, stretch and tone your muscles. Feel better As a holistic exercise system, Pilates is designed to elongate and strengthen the body, build a strong core and improve posture. Move better Progressively challenging advanced classes to push your limits. Perform better

traditional reformer pilates.long: An authentic blend of classical Pilates exercises and contemporary variations. Using spring tension to support and challenge you, expect to stretch, strengthen and tone in this full-body workout. Feel better. As a holistic exercise system, Pilates is designed to elongate and strengthen the body, build a strong core and improve posture. Perform better. Helping to support you in the sports you love most (and prevent injury) be it running, cycling, swimming, weight-training, golf, or tennis. Everyone benefits from the functional workout system of Reformer Pilates.

triathlon swim training.long: A coached, water based session focusing on technique, swim specific fitness and open water skills to enhance an athletes triathlon or open water performance.

trx.long: Challenge your muscular and cardiovascular systems with controlled lifting protocols and finish with high energy metabolic conditioning work. The complete TRX experience.

vinyasa yoga.long: Move fluidly from one pose to another by connecting body, mind and breath. Each class is unique, guided by the teacher’s individual style and training, offering a steady, but faster-paced flow. Improve strength, flexibility and mobility through regular practice. Expect a moving meditation that leaves you feeling energised, focused, and centred.

yard strong.long: The ultimate strength class. Expect log bars, farmer carries and more across 4 stations. Test your strength and challenge your body in a social and inclusive environment.

yard wod.long: Your Workout of the Day in the Yard. Inspired by cross training, expect “EMOMs” and “AMRAPs” as standard and be prepared to dig deep and push hard. The WOD combines effective high intensity training and strength work in an encouraging and motivating environment. All levels welcome Your trainer will ensure that you are working in a weight range that is right for you and sees you improving week on week. Functional Training There’s no hiding in The WOD, this is where hard work happens. By performing varied movements, at high intensity, The WOD will see you making progress in all areas of health and fitness. Motivation

yin yoga.long: Slow and meditative, Yin Yoga promotes flexibility, relaxation and energy flow by applying gentle, sustained pressure. Postures are held for 4-6 minutes for deep stretching of the body’s connective tissues. Ideal for stress relief, mindfulness, and increasing joint mobility.
